pages.text: The Processor runs Program Cards. It needs FE, at least one CPU core, enough RAM, and a Program Card in one of the card slots.
The top card slots hold programs. Expansion slots hold CPU, RAM, network, and graphics cards. Buffer slots are general storage for program operations.
Programs can be enabled from the Processor GUI. Runtime errors are shown in the GUI so you can return to the Programmer and fix the card.
